chains.title: No TF-mediated effect of rs7001688
predictions: The G>T change will not produce reproducible allele-specific CTCF occupancy or a variant-dependent change in a target gene in a relevant liver-cell context.
Any LDL-cholesterol association, if one exists, will not be mediated by a TF effect of rs7001688.

chains.title: Speculative alt-favored CTCF regulation of CYP7A1
chains.element: A possible CTCF-associated site at rs7001688; a regulatory element at this position is not established.

links.claim: This chain tests the hypothesis that T (alt) binds CTCF more strongly than G (ref). CTCF is the only listed bound, expressed TF with a binding model, but the overlapping peak is from LNCaP, not the relevant liver-cell context; no QBiC-SELEX model or result is supplied here to support the direction.
A CTCF peak overlaps the variant in LNCaP, but no cCRE overlaps the site and the evidence does not establish an active regulatory element in Hep 3B2.1-7.
CYP7A1 is an unvalidated candidate target, listed 926.8 kb from the variant by TSS distance; no variant-to-gene evidence is supplied.
CTCF is expressed in Hep 3B2.1-7, but no overlapping CTCF peak is reported in the HepG2 proxy for this cell context.
The supplied evidence does not establish a connection from rs7001688 or CYP7A1 regulation at this site to LDL cholesterol.

predictions: Unlike H0, this chain predicts that targeted allele comparison in a relevant liver-cell context will show greater CTCF occupancy on T than on G.
Unlike H2, this chain predicts that editing rs7001688 will preferentially alter CYP7A1 expression or its contact with the variant region, rather than FAM110B.
falsified_if: A relevant-cell allele-specific occupancy assay finds no reproducible CTCF binding difference, or finds stronger binding to G than T.
Variant perturbation produces no CYP7A1 expression or contact effect while producing a reproducible effect on another proposed target.
